gloss.en: to be done, to be carried out

examples.text: Pekerjaan ini harus dilakukan hari ini.

translation.en: This work has to be done today.
What can be done now?
There you go, the bus is coming!
Right, now let's start studying.
This city is safe for tourists.

examples.text: Simpan paspor di tempat yang aman.

translation.ar: احفظ جواز السفر في مكان آمن.
translation.en: Keep your passport in a safe place.

note.arz: من «أمان»، بس بتستخدم كصفة: aman = آمن.
note.en: From Arabic amān, used as an adjective: 'safe'.

translation.en: I sent the photos via WhatsApp.

translation.en: I bought a book at that shop.

Oh come on, don't joke!
This is a good chance to learn.
Give me one more chance.
I thought he'd gone home.
Think it over again carefully.

note.en: 'saya pikir' = I think; the full verb is 'berpikir'.

translation.en: What are you looking for?
I'm looking for the bathroom.
I was almost late this morning.
My work is nearly done.
The meeting is over.
When do you finish university?
Life in the village is very calm.

examples.text: Dia ingin kehidupan yang lebih baik.

translation.en: He wants a better life.

examples.text: Budaya Mesir dan Indonesia sangat berbeda.

translation.en: Egyptian and Indonesian cultures are very different.
We have different opinions.

Our plans changed because of the rain.

examples.text: Saya tidak peduli apa kata orang.

translation.arz: مش فارق معايا الناس تقول إيه.
translation.en: I don't care what people say.

translation.en: Why are you learning Indonesian?
Stop making excuses!

examples.text: Sari mendapat nilai bagus di ujian.

translation.ar: حصلت ساري على درجة جيدة في الامتحان.
translation.en: Sari got a good mark in the exam.
I got a message from Ahmad.

examples.text: Saya belajar bahasa Indonesia setiap hari.

translation.en: I study Indonesian every day.
My little brother is studying for an exam.

examples.text: Kami berjalan ke pasar setiap pagi.

translation.arz: إحنا بنمشي للسوق كل يوم الصبح.
translation.en: We walk to the market every morning.
Everything is going smoothly.
Let's eat together.
Come in, please sit down.

note.ar: أكثر تهذيبًا، وفي الكلام يقال ayo.

translation.en: Dad works at an oil company.

examples.text: Perusahaan itu punya kantor di Kairo.

translation.arz: الشركة دي عندها مكتب في القاهرة.
translation.en: That company has an office in Cairo.

Your voice isn't clear on the phone.

examples.text: Katakan saja apa yang kamu mau.

translation.en: Just say what you want.
What did he say just now?

note.arz: صيغة الأمر، أو بعد «yang» من غير «meN-»؛ الفعل الكامل «mengatakan».
note.ar: صيغة أمر أو بلا بادئة بعد yang، والكامل mengatakan.
note.en: Imperative, or used after 'yang' without meN-; full verb 'mengatakan'.

translation.en: Give this book to Budi.
Please give me some water.
When are you coming to Jakarta?
Let's eat together sometime.

note.arz: للسؤال بس؛ في الجملة العادية «ketika/waktu» = لما.
note.ar: للاستفهام فقط، وفي الجمل الخبرية يقال ketika أو waktu.
note.en: Only for questions; for 'when' in statements use 'ketika' or 'waktu'.

translation.en: My older brother studies in England.

examples.text: Dia bisa berbahasa Inggris dengan lancar.

translation.en: She speaks English fluently.

note.arz: بتتكتب بحرف كبير: Inggris، و«bahasa Inggris» = اللغة الإنجليزي.
note.ar: تُكتب بحرف كبير، و«bahasa Inggris» = اللغة الإنجليزية.
note.en: Written with a capital: Inggris; 'bahasa Inggris' = English (language).

translation.en: We eat in the dining room.

examples.text: Tidak ada ruang untuk koper lagi.

translation.en: There's no room for another suitcase.

note.arz: ruang لأوضة ليها وظيفة (ruang tamu = الصالون)، و«kamar» لأوضة النوم.
note.ar: ruang لغرفة ذات وظيفة، وkamar لغرفة النوم.
note.en: 'ruang' is a functional room (ruang tamu = living room); 'kamar' is a bedroom.

examples.text: Besok saya ke kantor jam delapan.

translation.ar: غدًا سأذهب إلى المكتب في الثامنة.
translation.en: Tomorrow I go to the office at eight.
See you tomorrow, Sari!
I'm off for two weeks.

examples.text: Hari Minggu kami pergi ke pantai.

translation.en: On Sunday we went to the beach.

note.arz: «minggu depan» = الأسبوع الجاي، و«hari Minggu» = يوم الحد.
note.ar: «minggu depan» = الأسبوع القادم، و«hari Minggu» = الأحد.

translation.en: That film is really interesting.

examples.text: Dia menarik kursi ke dekat meja.

translation.en: He pulled the chair up to the table.

The seabed there is very deep.
You lazybones, get up!
Mum gave me pocket money.
She fed her cat.
Your dress is really pretty today.
Dewi is a pretty girl.

note.en: For women and pretty things; for men use 'ganteng'.

translation.en: My phone fell on the floor.
Careful, don't fall!
Indonesian food is spicy and tasty.
What food do you like?

examples.text: Saya pulang ke Mesir akhir bulan ini.

translation.ar: سأعود إلى مصر نهاية هذا الشهر.
translation.en: I'm going back to Egypt at the end of this month.
Shall we meet this weekend?

note.arz: من «آخر»، بس معناها «النهاية»؛ «akhir pekan» = الويك إند.
note.ar: من «آخِر» بمعنى النهاية، و«akhir pekan» = عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
note.en: From Arabic ākhir; means 'end'. 'akhir pekan' = weekend.

translation.en: Jakarta is the capital of Indonesia.

examples.text: Nasi merupakan makanan pokok di sini.

translation.en: Rice is the staple food here.

note.arz: زي «adalah» بس أرسمى، بتلاقيها في الكتب والأخبار.
note.en: A formal equivalent of 'adalah' (is), common in writing.

examples.text: Di mana saya bisa dapatkan tiket?

translation.en: Where can I get a ticket?

examples.text: Apa yang kamu dapatkan dari kursus itu?

translation.en: What did you get out of that course?

examples.text: Gadis itu tinggal di sebelah rumah saya.

translation.en: That girl lives next door to me.

examples.text: Dia gadis yang pintar dan ramah.

translation.en: She's a clever, friendly girl.
The scenery in Bali is beautiful.
Her voice is lovely.

note.en: For scenery, sounds, things; for people use 'cantik'.

examples.text: Gue nggak tau rumahnya di mana.

translation.en: I don't know where his house is.

note.arz: نطق الكلام لـ «tahu»؛ ماتلخبطهاش مع «tahu» = توفو.
note.ar: النطق العامي لـ tahu، وtahu أيضًا تعني التوفو.
note.en: Spoken form of 'tahu' (to know); 'tahu' also means tofu.

translation.en: Why are you so quiet?
Quiet! The baby's sleeping.

translation.ar: كان ينبغي أن ترتاح في البيت.
translation.en: You should rest at home.

translation.ar: كان من المفترض أن تصل الحافلة.
translation.en: The bus should have arrived by now.

translation.ar: هطل المطر بغزارة حتى غمرت المياه الطريق.
translation.en: It rained hard, so the road flooded.

examples.text: Dia rajin belajar sehingga lulus ujian.

translation.ar: اجتهد في الدراسة فنجح في الامتحان.
translation.en: He studied hard, so he passed the exam.

note.en: Shows a result; 'agar' shows a purpose.

examples.text: Kamu gila? Jangan lompat dari situ!

translation.ar: هل جننت؟ لا تقفز من هناك!
translation.en: Are you crazy? Don't jump from there!
Man, the traffic is insane!

note.arz: بتتقال كتير بين الصحاب للتعجب؛ مش شتيمة جامدة بس خليها للكلام العادي.
note.ar: تُستعمل للتعجب بين الأصدقاء، وليست شتيمة قوية.
note.en: Common as an exclamation among friends; not a strong insult, but casual.

translation.en: Our teacher is still young.

examples.text: Saya mau tas warna biru muda.

translation.en: I'd like a light blue bag.

note.en: Opposite of 'tua' for both age and colour.

translation.en: We flew to Bali.

examples.text: Pesawat telepon ada di meja itu.

translation.en: The telephone set is on that table.

note.en: 'naik pesawat' = to fly, take a plane.

translation.en: This is just a temporary home.

examples.text: Ibu memasak, sementara ayah membaca koran.

translation.en: Mum cooks while Dad reads the paper.

examples.text: Kucing itu ada di belakang pintu.

examples.text: Kereta tiba di Surabaya jam sembilan.

translation.ar: يصل القطار إلى سورابايا في التاسعة.

translation.en: We've just arrived at the hotel.
The people at the market are very friendly.
People started going home.
I'd like to drink sweet tea.
Don't forget to take your medicine.
This bread has gone hard.
Don't talk so loudly.

note.en: From Arabic awwal; means 'beginning', not the ordinal 'first' (that's 'pertama').

translation.en: Don't forget to bring an umbrella.
What did you bring for the picnic?
Let's watch a movie tonight.
That film is from Egypt.

Yeah, I'll call later.

translation.en: I hope I can go to Indonesia next year.

examples.text: Raja itu tinggal di istana besar.

note.en: 'tanah air' = homeland; a room's floor is 'lantai'.

translation.arz: لو سمحت هات شنطتي من العربية.
translation.ar: من فضلك أحضر حقيبتي من السيارة.

note.ar: تدل على جهد أكبر من mencoba.

note.ar: تُكتب بحرف كبير، و«Amerika Serikat» = الولايات المتحدة.
note.en: Written with a capital; 'Amerika Serikat' = the United States.

note.en: For 'to build', the full verb is 'membangun'.

translation.arz: ألف سلامة، يا رب تخف بسرعة!
translation.en: Get well soon!
Hopefully it won't rain tomorrow.

examples.text: Saya mendengar suara aneh tadi malam.

Did you hear that news?

The test results show he's healthy.

examples.text: Perempuan itu guru bahasa Inggris saya.

translation.en: My daughter is five years old.
How are you, Ahmad?
I have good news for you.

note.arz: «apa kabar?» = إزيك؟ (حرفيًا: إيه الأخبار؟)، والرد «baik» = كويس.
note.en: 'apa kabar?' = how are you? (literally 'what news?'); reply 'baik'.

examples.text: Saya harus pergi ke dokter hari ini.

note.ar: لا علاقة لها بـ«قمر»، و«kamar mandi» = الحمّام.
note.en: Nothing to do with Arabic qamar (moon); 'kamar mandi' = bathroom.

translation.ar: فاز المنتخب المصري بهدفين دون رد.
translation.en: Egypt won two-nil.
Who won that contest?

examples.text: Dia punya kekuatan yang luar biasa.

translation.en: He has extraordinary strength.
